name: Hero
description: Piqueray Hero. Extracted from the Figma COMPONENT_SET on DS · Organisms, reviewed and adopted — not authored. The contract owns the complete Hero stack: a photographic Background plane, a mandatory VoileNavigation plane above the photo for header readability, then the content plane. The top veil is intrinsic to every Hero; it is neither a Page override nor a variant. The separate Titres scrim remains attached to the text area. The root is fluid while 1728 px remains its canvas authoring reference. SectionHeader and the rich SousTitre are parent-width Fill; the Button remains Hug.

props.name: backgroundUrl
props.description: Code-only source of the root's photographic IMAGE fill (fills[0], imageRef b9ae58d2e309c55241eb843c1a36d90d087c1483). The master exposes no component property for it — A5 / §a.7 means the bitmap has no contract→canvas transport, so it rides a code-side scalar and the canvas keeps the engine's placeholder.

props.name: backgroundAlt
props.description: Alternative text for the background photo plane. Empty by default: the Figma paint is decorative — it carries no information the surrounding copy does not already state.

props.name: sousTitre
props.description: The hero paragraph (layer « Sous-titre », node 2111:3380) as a governed rich-text prop — 016/T042, lot B013-4: the 2026-08-05 live diagnosis showed this was the master's ONE unbound text, and lot L-B013-4 (T041) exposes the native TEXT property « SousTitre » it binds to. The two observed 700 ranges (« performance », « la solution idéale ») travel as segments; the Figma projection flattens to the property's native string value.

Background.description: The root's fills[0] IMAGE paint as a photo plane. Out of flow (position: absolute) so it does not join the root's flex row; the emitter's replaced-element chrome then sizes it to the full inset box, which is the faithful statement — a Figma paint fills its NODE rather than occupying a box of its own, so no fixed 1728×640 is restated here. object-fit: cover reproduces scaleMode FILL (centered; the paint carries no imageTransform). Declared FIRST so the later positioned sibling paints over it.

VoileNavigation.description: Mandatory Hero-owned top veil. It sits above the photo and below all Hero content so an overlaid Page header remains readable without a Page-specific patch.

sousTitre.description: Rich Hero paragraph bound to the native SousTitre text property. Its two bold ranges remain governed by content.marks.strong. Width is parent-owned Fill, so the neighbouring Hug button keeps its measured width while the paragraph absorbs the available space.
